training_contract.task_conditioning: identity input adapters for encoder and processor
training_contract.native_loss: channel-balanced clean-field denoising plus spatial differences
training_contract.observation_loss: group-balanced fair CRPS plus spatial-increment fair CRPS

inputs.domain: All finite wet latitudes; zero-normalized missing surface inputs
inputs.uncertainty: Independent conditional diffusion readouts along one deterministic latent path; not coherent ensemble trajectories
inputs.member_fields: SST, SSH, temperature at550m, salinity at550m at all73 five-day leads; member means are separate point outputs

intervention.alternating_tasks: OM4 then observation; 128 each at full budget
intervention.spatial: existing nearest-neighbor term retained; optional four directions at lags 1/2/4/8 divided by grid distance
intervention.stability: last four OM4 microbatches use intervention; first four retain original objective
intervention.replay: four detached on-policy latent chains; burn-in 30/90/180/300d; six steps per use; reset after four uses or 360d
intervention.long_unroll: 12 differentiable steps, decode last six plus initial; original six-step cohort preserved in first four microbatches
